question: List retailers with their total boxes scanned and total earnings in July 2026
business_requirement: Pre-aggregate box scans and wallet earnings in independent CTEs before joining to prevent Cartesian row multiplication.
relevant_business_rules: Separate CTE for scans: SUM(qpm.box_calculation_uom) grouped by retailer
Separate CTE for earnings: SUM(wt.amount) grouped by retailer with reference_type whitelist and amount > 0
LEFT JOIN scans with earnings on retailer_id
expected_sql: WITH retailer_scans AS (SELECT r.id AS retailer_id, r.name AS retailer_name, SUM(qpm.box_calculation_uom) AS total_boxes_scanned FROM sku_inventories si JOIN sku_qr_points_maps qpm ON si.sku_code = qpm.sku_code JOIN users r ON si.status_retailer_id = r.id WHERE r.user_role = 2 AND si.retailer_scanned_at >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00' AND si.retailer_scanned_at < '2026-08-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY r.id, r.name), retailer_earnings AS (SELECT u.id AS retailer_id, SUM(wt.amount) AS total_earnings FROM users u JOIN wallet_transaction wt ON u.id = wt.user_id WHERE u.user_role = 2 AND wt.reference_type IN ('topup', 'cash_point', 'referral_earning', 'coupon_redeem') AND wt.amount > 0 AND wt.created_at >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00' AND wt.created_at < '2026-08-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY u.id) SELECT rs.retailer_name, rs.total_boxes_scanned, COALESCE(re.total_earnings, 0) AS total_earnings FROM retailer_scans rs LEFT JOIN retailer_earnings re ON rs.retailer_id = re.retailer_id ORDER BY rs.total_boxes_scanned DESC LIMIT 10;

relevant_business_rules: Box quantity calculation: SUM(qpm.box_calculation_uom) joined on sku_inventories.sku_code = qpm.sku_code
NEVER use COUNT(si.id) for box quantities
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(qpm.box_calculation_uom) AS total_boxes_scanned FROM sku_inventories si JOIN sku_qr_points_maps qpm ON si.sku_code = qpm.sku_code WHERE si.retailer_scanned_at >= '2026-06-01 00:00:00' AND si.retailer_scanned_at < '2026-07-01 00:00:00';

question: Show retailer earnings with retailer names for July 2026
business_requirement: Execute query answering: 'Show retailer earnings with retailer names for July 2026'
expected_sql: SELECT u.id, u.name, SUM(wt.amount) AS total_earnings FROM users u JOIN wallet_transaction wt ON u.id = wt.user_id WHERE u.user_role = 2 AND wt.amount > 0 AND wt.created_at >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00' AND wt.created_at < '2026-08-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY u.id, u.name;
